_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global specialty biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (Item 1A heading); 'We could lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on several key products for most of our revenues, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY08-FY16 ex-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.1%/yr (Q1 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.8%/yr (FY08-FY16 ex-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY16 ex-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2018-05-25) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.06x (81.0% downside to Bear $10 / +76.2% upside to Bull $93) | Adj composite 2.42 vs market 2.12: gap +0.30 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +7% above the EPP floor $50 (18x FY18E $2.75) | Conservative 2-yr case: +18.2% total (+9.1%/yr) | At 19.2x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $70 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues +1.5% in Q1 2018, forward revenues +1% (no FY18 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2018 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
